author: Lunatic143
title: Unreliable
review_text: When I load money from my banking app, the app notifies me when the money is deducted in few seconds. Whereas in Esewa it takes hours to show the loaded money. You seriously need to work on it. Very poor service.

author: Flashy Fish
title: Not for foreigners
review_text: First of all, it’s not designed for foreigners in Nepal. Charging is easily done, but a payment is limited within Rs5000 and sending money isn’t available without verification. Now it doesn’t connect the network through data and totally useless. Nothing but stealing money.
